description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kadawalamadiththa, Kandy Four Gravets and Gangawata Koralaya D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320294
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including ownership details, property boundaries, encumbrances, and legal status of land titles. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and property rights, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
